name: readly-monorepo
description: Render Markdown exactly like GitHub does, locally, without pushing.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @readly/core && npm run build -w @groundwork/readly && npm run build -w @readly/web
scripts.build:cli: npm run build -w @readly/core && npm run build -w @groundwork/readly
scripts.dev:web: npm run build -w @readly/core && npm run dev -w @readly/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @readly/core && npm run test -w @groundwork/readly
